about: Every published data file needs an entry: its sources and what it contains. tools/audit_public.py reads this file. Flags: iea_figures = contains IEA-derived figures (confirm IEA terms before the repo goes public); iea_quotes = quotes short IEA wording; secondary_article_figures = figures from secondary articles (attributed); lme_statistics_only = statistics derived from licensed LME data, never LME values; large_ok = a derived series with 100 or more rows that was checked on purpose.
